entities.summary: Richard Edmund Pates is an American Catholic prelate who served as bishop of Des Moines in Iowa from 2008 to 2019 and as an auxiliary bishop of the Archdiocese of St. Paul and Minneapolis in Minnesota from 2000 to 2008.
